# Bus Priority Impact Studio

Bus Priority Impact Studio publishes route-first evidence pages for NYC bus priority planning.

## Public pages

- [Route search and priority overview](https://buspriorityimpact.studio/)
- [M15 SBS route evidence page](https://buspriorityimpact.studio/routes/m15-sbs)
- [M15 SBS segment ladder](https://buspriorityimpact.studio/routes/m15-sbs/ladder)
- [Precomputed findings](https://buspriorityimpact.studio/findings)
- [Cited route evidence briefs](https://buspriorityimpact.studio/briefs)
- [Source and methodology notes](https://buspriorityimpact.studio/methods)
- [Human and agent API documentation](https://buspriorityimpact.studio/docs)

## API

- [OpenAPI 3.1 contract](https://buspriorityimpact.studio/api/openapi.json)
- [Route cards](https://buspriorityimpact.studio/api/v1/studio/routes)
- [Search API example](https://buspriorityimpact.studio/api/v1/studio/search?q=manhattan+ace)
